data.title: Flex Basic – The Sherbourne, 561 Sherbourne St
data.description: Furnished private room in a shared 3-bedroom suite with 1 bathroom, at The Sherbourne, 561 Sherbourne St, Toronto. The Sherbourne is a modern high-rise rental close to Sherbourne and Bloor, about a five-minute walk from Sherbourne Station on Line 2, with Toronto Metropolitan University and the University of Toronto within walking distance. Residents share a concierge, fitness centre, yoga area, theatre room, games room, party room, lounge and library, and an outdoor terrace. The all-inclusive price covers furniture, high-speed WiFi and all utilities (hydro, water, heat). Minimum stay is 6 months.
